notes.title: All Haze Eve Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30053664/5a4c32eca5a34f69c36c47fed52444197a099bd8.png[/img]
Following the initial launch of All Haze Eve on Game Jolt and itch.io last year, I'm excited to announce a new and improved version for Steam!

The latest release contains the following improvements:
[list]
[*]Added mouse support
[*]Less ambiguous controller setup
[*]Tailored tutorial messages
[*]Helpful NPC dialog order
[*]9 achievements
[*]18 avatars
[/list]
This makes it the best version of All Haze Eve yet. Just in time for Halloween!
